annotations.title: Send a Candidate the Ruzora Coding Challenge

description: Runs Ruzora's coding challenge + technical questions (~25 min, free) on a candidate the user found; returns a candidate link and a status link. Needs the user's confirmation that the candidate knows. Sends both names, the email, company and profile links to Ruzora.

buyer_token.description: Proof the user verified this work email: the buyer_token from confirm_work_email (valid 7 days). No token yet? Call verify_work_email first.

candidate_informed.description: True only when the user has confirmed the candidate knows they will receive a technical assessment from Ruzora on the company's behalf.

requester_name.description: Full name of the person hiring

role.description: Role being hired, e.g. "Senior backend engineer"

work_email.description: Their WORK email (personal inboxes are refused). The report and status go here.

name: send_coding_challenge
